description: Opus LL V10 (staged serializer): a queued action's `order` changed in one stage decides a later one. Sableye's Prankster Quash (+1) sets Garchomp's pending Dragon Claw to order 201 (`action.order = 201`: after every other move, whatever the re-sorts after each action), so the slower Tyranitar's Stone Edge (80%) goes first and knocks out Garchomp (patched to 40 HP) unless it misses; only then does Garchomp's Dragon Claw hit Tyranitar. Without Quash, Garchomp (Speed 169 vs 81) would move first.
